_comment: Deterministic resolver maps used by app/lib/knowledge-resolver.js. Not extracted from cache files (these encode design decisions, not MCS-published facts). Review + edit here — do not edit the JS fallback copies. Loaded at server startup; knowledge-resolver falls back to inline defaults if this file is missing.

workIqMap._comment: M365 keyword → Work IQ server mapping. When /mcs-research matches a capability text against these keywords, the resolver boosts the matching Work IQ MCP server (Priority 1a). Add keywords here when new M365 surfaces ship Work IQ coverage (e.g., 'loop', 'whiteboard').

capabilityTypePatterns._comment: Regex patterns for heuristic implementation-type detection. Order matters — first match wins for confidence boost. Edit here when new capability verbs emerge (e.g., 'approve', 'review', 'summarize').

patterns.reason: Question-answering or info-retrieval verbs suggest a knowledge-source-backed topic
Write/action verbs suggest a Power Automate flow
Routing/decision verbs suggest a rule-based topic
Read-only data access verbs suggest a tool (MCP server or connector)

priorityLadder._comment: Mirror of knowledge/frameworks/component-selection.md priority ladder. Used by cheat sheet generation so the wizard LLM sees the ordering. Update when framework doc changes.

tiers.examples: Work IQ Copilot + Work IQ User — covers all M365 data
Dataverse, Dynamics 365, Fabric, GitHub, Learn Docs, Sentinel
Power Automate flows, Dataverse, custom connectors
Azure Functions, Azure AI, Azure Storage
SharePoint, Outlook, Teams (only if Work IQ unavailable)
Custom MCP servers, HTTP endpoints, community tools
